title: Choose a path
summary: Assembly: Choose a path. Compare rbx with 4.
introduction: cmp compares values and sets flags. je jumps when the compared values are equal.

blocks.text: On x86-64 Linux, save lesson.asm. Run nasm -f elf64 lesson.asm -o lesson.o, then ld lesson.o -o lesson. Run ./lesson, then printf 'exit code: %s\n' "$?" immediately.

blocks.title: Choose a path
blocks.code:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    mov rdi, 0
    mov rbx, 5
    cmp rbx, 5
    je .same
    jmp .done
.same:
    mov rdi, 1
.done:
    mov rax, 60
    syscall

blocks.text: cmp finds equality, so je reaches .same and sets rdi to 1.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A jump uses flags from the previous comparison; avoid changing them first.
